$description: Primitives: named paint, no roles. Nothing outside design/tokens/theme.json should reference these directly — a component that wants 'teal' wants 'accent'.

teal.$description: The brand hue. Hue 188, chosen over the Tailwind indigo it replaced: that hex is the default accent of half this category, and teal is nearly absent from it. Cool against the warm Mocha Mousse neutrals, which is the point — complementary temperature rather than the usual cool-on-cool. Lightness was solved per step to land on the contrasts the old accent held, so nothing downstream shifted. Watch the one weak spot: at 46 degrees this is the closest the accent has ever sat to the success green, so an accent chip beside a success chip needs deliberate spacing or a different shape.

mocha.$description: Mocha Mousse — the warm hue the neutrals are tinted with, the landing aurora, and the one warm ink the interface is allowed. It reads as earth rather than as a signal because of its saturation, 26% against the warning amber's 92%, not because of its hue, which sits only 20 degrees away.

600.$description: Mocha deep enough to be an ink on the light ground — 4.97 against it, where the 500 manages only 3.63.

warm.$description: Neutrals, warm rather than grey. 950-800 carry the dark theme, 300-100 the light one.

slate.$description: Cool text greys. Deliberately not warm: body copy stays neutral against the warm ground.

signal.$description: State, not brand. Identical in both themes on purpose.
